examples.derivation: The rectangular end has width 3.6 and height 2.1; extrusion depth is 3. Front, right-side and top projections therefore have dimensions 3.6 by 2.1, 3 by 2.1 and 3.6 by 3. Each separate solution block preserves its complete rectangle.

The triangular end has width 3 and height 2.4, with its apex at horizontal position 1.5; extrusion depth is 4. The front projection is that triangle, the right-side projection is a 4 by 2.4 rectangle, and the top projection is a 3 by 4 rectangle with its ridge at horizontal position 1.5.

Each rear polygon is translated by (0.9,0.6), corresponding to depth 2 under the stated projection. Matching corners yield 9, 12, 15 and 18 edges for the triangular prism, cube, pentagonal prism and hexagonal prism. The cube has width, height and actual depth 2. For the pentagon, the upper-left outward normal (-0.9,1.2,0) has viewing dot product -0.045; its rear edge and left connector are correctly dashed. The four sketches follow Volume Development Q2.

Both solution prisms retain their supplied end polygons and translate rear corners by (0.8,0.6). The L-shaped prism preserves the tall left portion. In the T-shaped prism, the exposed rear left ledge runs from (0.8,1.7) to (1.4,1.7), where the front stem obscures its continuation. The separate front view exactly reproduces the original L outline. These constructions adapt the source end-face exercises.

For (a), the triangular end is 2.8 wide and 2.2 high, with depth 3.5. The reconstruction uses offset (1.05,0.7), matching depth times projection coefficients (0.3,0.2). Its ridge projects to the top-view line at 1.4. For (b), the trapezium spans width 3.4, height 2 and top endpoints 0.7 and 2.7; depth 3.8 gives offset (1.14,0.76). These endpoints produce the two supplied internal top-view lines. All six question views retain their outlines in separate blocks.

The front-view vertical dimension supplies height 4 m, the top-view horizontal dimension supplies width 5 m, and the side-view horizontal dimension supplies depth 7 m. At uniform factor 0.5 these become 2, 2.5 and 3.5 coordinate units. Depth projection gives offset (1.05,0.7). The solution labels the corresponding front horizontal, front vertical and receding edges correctly.
